_comment: A nature damage-over-time aura on the nearest enemy: each new burn deals 10.5 HP plus 2.6111 per level over 3 ticks spaced 60 ticks apart, reapplying every 20 ticks. Cost charges only on igniting a fresh burn, not on refreshing one already burning. All values placeholder; mirrors the fire equivalent aura's numbers with the damage type swapped.
name: Blight
